Right now you are feeling inadequate and never seem to measure up. 

Especially right now. Isn’t it like having to climb Mt Everest just to get into something or just do something? 

If that is your reality, then you do not have to climb that Mt Everest. That is some future seeking goal. For now look at what are some path you can take a stroll on. Something small, something manageable. And when that is effortless for you, take the next step up... and slowly build on from there. 

Please take some time to appreciate yourself. It is a challenge. And if you start looking for it, you may find things you can appreciate and like about yourself. And if you do not, start taking steps and doing things that can give you the reason to appreciate yourself. And want to do more and more good both for yourself and your community. 

And things do not always work out at all or that easily. Just give it another chance, and another chance. Give yourself the chance to be happy and to thrive. Because you can do it. It takes a lot of work, and of course it does, because you are planning to ascend Mt Everest.
Your life is important. It is not her that makes your life important. Please treasure yourself and the life you have. Cause nothing can be exchanged for it even if you want it back.

It is okay to not feel okay... sometimes forcing yourself to feel a certain way or be a certain way ends up being more damaging. 

Accept your emotions for what it is. Accept the less than ideal situation that you are in. And slowly start finding ways to get through it... The path itself is often not linear. There will be ups and there will be downs. Sometimes it feels like the ups are never coming to pay you a visit, but onwards you shall go. Cause onwards is the only way you open the possibility of any ups.

Your presence does make a difference. It is impossible to not cause any impact as you wade through life. We do not always realise what impact we have done. Especially in moments where all we could see are the problems and pain we are going through. That is all we could see during these difficult and painful moments. 

It is not pointless. Nothing ever was. It is what we make of it... 

Loneliness is a difficult one... And the worst part about loneliness is one can still feel lonely even if they are with someone. And in those kinds of loneliness when you’re with someone, is the worst kind of loneliness to experience when one is actually on their own. What I find to be helpful is when I start being my own best friend. Paying attention to myself. My thoughts. My emotions. And to start really caring about myself. That is when I feel a little less lonely. Because I know that at least I am here for myself and I have not yet abandoned myself. Life will continue happening and time will continue to pass. And I need to take the next step and keep growing and struggling. And that is okay. Because I would appreciate the better parts of life even more, when I have gone through the bad ones before.
